installationLifecycle.install: npm install completes the CLI phase; then sealseek-media skill install --agent AGENT --path OWN_SKILL_DIRECTORY --json
installationLifecycle.update: sealseek-media update install --yes --agent AGENT --path OWN_SKILL_DIRECTORY --json; verify both components after any direct npm upgrade
installationLifecycle.verification: sealseek-media version and skill status --agent AGENT --path OWN_SKILL_DIRECTORY --json; complete only when installed and current are true

automaticUpdates.trigger: ordinary task entries, excluding help/version/skill/task following
automaticUpdates.configuration: private update policy; update auto on|off|status
automaticUpdates.recovery: offline checks retain current CLI; selected managed Skill synchronization is verified independently

ffprobe.recovery: Install package with optional dependencies enabled; or configure a working ffprobe executable. Inspect the same task after repair.
